messages:
jen: Quick heads-up 20	4 prepping release notes for v2.3.0 (runtime kernel tweaks + batching improvements). Target change window: Mon 2026-03-22 00:00–02:00 PST. Who can draft the internal blast and pin the message? Need rollback criteria + deploybot cadence.

alex-pm: I can sketch the internal blurb. Can someone add the rollback thresholds? I want the announcement short: two bullets (what, impact) and a link to the RN doc.

rachel-docs: I can author the RN draft. Will do summary + one-line upgrade guidance. Assign me the pin if nobody else volunteers.

nate: Ill own rollback thresholds and canary lanes. Proposal: abort and roll back if 5xx rate > 0.5% for 5m in canary or median p95 latency increases by >40% vs baseline for 10m.

sam-oncall: +1 to those thresholds. Add an automatic rollback trigger for error budget burn of >60% in any region for 15m.

ops-lead: Deploy cadence: staging -> canary (5% traffic 30m) -> ramp 50% 30m -> full. Deploy-bot will run the sequence. If canary fails, deploy-bot will pause and ping oncall.

deploy-bot: [system] Scheduled rollout pipeline created: release=v2.3.0, lanes=[staging,canary,global], canary_percent=5, canary_duration=30m, roll_ramp=[50% after 30m], owner=@nate

jen: Rachel, can you include a short line in the internal blast about pinning model versions and the policy: we pin to model@v2.3.0 on hosted and explicit fallback to v2.2.x if capacity constraints detected.

rachel-docs: Yep. Draft coming.

rachel-docs: Draft (please quick review):
"Heads-up: Rolling out v2.3.0 on Mon 03/22 00:00–02:00 PST. Includes runtime kernel selection and batching improvements to cut e2e latency and token cost. Expected user-facing change: none; internal metrics: lower p95 and reduced per-token cost. Rollout plan: staging -> 5% canary (30m) -> 50% -> 100%. Rollback criteria: 5xx >0.5% for 5m, p95 >40% above baseline for 10m, or error budget burn >60% for 15m. Owner: @nate. Pinning: services will be pinned to model@v2.3.0; fallback to model@v2.2.x if rolled back. Oncall contact: @sam-oncall. See full release notes: <https://redwood.internal/releases/v2.3.0>"

alex-pm: Nice and concise. Can we add one line telling folks where to find the deploybot playbook and the rollback runbook?

rachel-docs: Added. Updated draft includes links to deploybot runbook and rollback checklist.

jen: OK 20 Rachel will publish the RN and pin. Nate/ops to validate thresholds in deploybot. Sam, please be on standby during the window and confirm pager rotation.

sam-oncall: Standby confirmed. Ill escalate to eng-sre if we hit thresholds.

nate: Ive added the thresholds to deploy-bot config. Quick snippet:

```
deploybot set-trigger --release v2.3.0 \
  --canary 5 --canary-duration 30m \
  --abort-on 5xx>0.5%:5m,latency_p95>40%:10m,error_budget>60%:15m
```

deploy-bot: [system] Triggers updated and saved. Next: start pipeline at 2026-03-22T00:00:00-08:00

jen: Perfect. Final checklist before publish:
- RN doc link updated
- Pinning line present
- Deploybot triggers committed
- Oncall standby confirmed
- Ops brief pinned (Rachel)

rachel-docs: Ill publish RN and pin to #eng-releases in ~15m. Will attach the deploybot playbook and rollback checklist.

alex-pm: Ill prep a one-line post for #general summarizing customer impact (none expected) once RN is pinned.

jen: Thanks everyone. If anything changes, update this thread. :thumbsup:
